QuestInfo.name: Dark Sea Investigation
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p1101002# has a new mission for you...
QuestInfo.1: You received a new mission. Minions of the Black Mage seem to be showing up in the Aqua Road Deep Sea region of #b#m230040400##k. Find out what their goal is.
QuestInfo.2: You ran into the Black Mage's minions at #b#m230040400##k.

0.0: Oh. You. I almost forgot about you. But since you're here... I have a task.
0.1: I've received word that members of the #rBlack Wings#k have been spotted around #b#m230040400##k, in the Aqua Road Deep Sea region.
0.2: They must be there for a reason. Find out what it is.\r\n(You will be moved to The Grave of a Wrecked Ship after you accept.)

no.0: Please do not waste my time. I have precious little of it as it is.

npc.0: Thoroughly investigate #b#m230040400##k. Report to me any abnormalities.
